To the right, two female vocalists stand at microphones. The stage floor appears to be wooden planks with visible gaps. In the foreground, there are large black monitor speakers and red wedge monitors. The background features complex stage lighting rigs with blue and red beams cutting through haze/smoke.

The base of the microphone stand on the far right appears to float or merge ambiguously with the stage floor cables, lacking a solid grounding point.
The black monitor speaker in the bottom center has ill-defined edges where it meets the red wedge monitor; the boundaries bleed into each other slightly.
